body.objective: Freeze the Phase 1 counterflow viability classification by deciding whether any robust stationary retuning preserves the complete causal, trace, charge, pairing and all-isotype physical-health structure.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal Hamiltonian-Hopf retuning-locus theorem, TWO_PHASE_COUNTERFLOW_CAUSAL_BV_PARENT_V2, the repaired graded q70 parent and the terminal low-j/stabilizer ledger by exact hashes. Branch first on the retuning theorem. If the connected stationary action locus contains no semisimple purely oscillatory j=1/2 candidate compatible with the background, causal-parent, dressed-trace and charge gates, freeze the exact classification ending and stop without opening another action architecture. If only an isolated multiple-root/collision point exists, classify its codimension, Jordan/Krein collision and instability on every punctured neighbourhood; it is not a pass. Only for a candidate lying on an open stationary sublocus, or protected by an exact structural identity, independently rebuild the complete 70-row causal parent and contraction and prove that their ranks, support-local identities and dressed-trace elimination persist. Then compute the complete physical quotient for every generic and exceptional SU(2)_L x U(1)_R isotype, all allowed right weights and both k signs: characteristic roots, geometric multiplicities, Jordan chains, reduced pairing/radical/inertia, Krein signatures, spatial gradient/principal cones and D/R_rel/K/Q_rel dispositions. Prove uniform all-isotype stability by exact representation/asymptotic structure rather than a finite cutoff. A pass requires purely oscillatory semisimple physical roots, no replacement zero-frequency Jordan block, acceptable nonradical pairing signs, unchanged causal contraction and coherent charge interpretation throughout an open part of the stationary locus or under the stated structural identity. Otherwise freeze the first exact all-isotype obstruction. Supply content-addressed artifacts, strict schemas, independent algebraic/representation and interval/asymptotic rails, adversarial collision/cutoff/gauge-deletion mutations, tier receipt, report, atlas fragment and Phase 1 paper disposition.
body.current_gate: Phase 1 classification ending versus robust complete-unary candidate selection
body.forbid: no isolated multiple root called stable; no first-block pass called all-isotype health; no finite harmonic cutoff called uniform stability; no changed field content, derivative order, gauge generator or nonlocal constraint hidden as retuning; no rank-changing parent called the same causal theory; no radical, charged orbit or fixed-charge clock deletion used to improve signs; no causal completeness called positivity; no nonlinear, observer, quantum, particle or unitarity promotion
activates: the Phase 1 classification ending if no robust locus survives
or action-specific Nonlinear, Observer and Quantum consumption if a robust complete-unary locus passes
body.resource_hint: PHASE 1 DECISION JOIN. Do not search a new theory. Consume the exact retuning and low-j results; an architectural no-go and a robust all-isotype pass are equally valid terminal scientific outcomes, but only the latter activates candidate-specific downstream calculations.
